headline: How to farm Ancient Civilization Parts
title: How to Farm Ancient Civilization Parts in Palworld | Fastest Method | Palworld Guide
video_script: Need Ancient Civilization Parts in Palworld? The main source is Alpha Pals. Field Alphas respawn, so you can farm them again and again. Pick a few easy Alphas close to fast travel points and run a loop. If your level is much higher than the Alpha, you can take it down in seconds. Pro tip: capture the Alpha and butcher it for a second drop roll. Dungeon bosses drop them too, but they take longer to reach. How many parts do you need? Comment below!

scenes.sub: The main source - and they respawn
